attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Veterinary Medicine (OPLC)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored or approved by AAVSB RACE, AAHA, AVMA, AVMA-accredited veterinary colleges, state and regional VMAs, NAVC/VMX, WVC, Fetch dvm360, ACVC, specialty colleges and associations listed in Vet 403.01(b); other courses by board approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates of a veterinary education program need no CE for their first renewal after graduation.
rules.audit_note: Licensees are audited per Plc 308.04(d); keep certificates (RACE number on RACE courses) at least 3 years.

topics.who: Opioid use or prescribing of opioids

rules.notes: 30 h in the 24 months before renewal, at least 6 h in each 12-month period; min 24 h medical; max 6 h non-medical, 6 h USDA, 4 h complementary/alternative, 1 h wellness; at least 50% in person or live interactive, max 50% prerecorded.
